svg.title: Sere
svg.desc: North-up layout and numbered route key. 1. Skiff approach. 2. Broken rail. 3. Baker’s sill. 4. Fishwives’ gutter. 5. Market Steps. 6. Survey cut.
svg.text: Step ashore at the last run of rail
Call the berth from the last post
Slack joint and sheltered bow notch
Sight the third berth from the cross
North up · Routes and footprints at blockout scale
